10xteam-10xteam:ashbyhq:7a7ab45b-647b-48.title: PR Specialist/Journalist – AI Trainer - Freelance - 8-20 hrs/week - Remote
10xteam-10xteam:ashbyhq:7a7ab45b-647b-48.description: Updated: 07 July 2026 Freelance | 8–20 hrs/week | Remote (EU/UK) Are you an experienced PR specialist who instinctively spots gaps in messaging, media strategy, or campaign execution and understands the complex realities of modern PR practice? Do you have 8 to 20 hours per week available alongside your main job or consulting projects? Join us in shaping how AI understands and applies PR expertise at scale. About the Role 10x.team connects expert freelancers with leading AI labs building next-generation models. We are looking for knowledgeable PR specialists based in the EU or UK to enhance the accuracy, depth, and real-world relevance of AI-powered PR systems. What You Will Do - Review and refine AI-generated outputs related to PR strategies, media engagement, messaging frameworks, and practical aspects of PR work - Evaluate AI responses for PR accuracy, practicality, and compliance with real-world best practices - Draft realistic PR scenarios based on your direct professional experience - Create scenario variations from different perspectives (e.g. PR specialist, client, journalist, or brand spokesperson) - Identify gaps, oversights, or weak reasoning in AI-generated PR content In simple terms: You will assess and improve AI-generated content, ensuring it reflects sound PR reasoning, authentic campaign documentation, and practical procedures. Rather than running traditional PR projects, you’ll apply your expertise to help AI systems understand and reason about PR processes at scale. Who You Are - A senior-level PR specialist with significant professional experience within the EU or UK - Experienced in advising on, preparing, and executing PR campaigns and strategies - Skilled at evaluating PR documentation, methodologies, and compliance with best practices - Comfortable working independently and providing structured, critical feedback - Available for 8–20 hours per week, with prompt availability Why Join? - Flexible, fully remote freelance work that fits your current commitments - Apply your PR expertise in a rapidly evolving, high-impact AI environment - Directly contribute to building advanced AI PR systems - Free access to our in-house AI Academy to further develop your AI skillset - Clear onboarding, structured tasks, and ongoing opportunities for collaboration How to Apply: After applying, you’ll receive an email detailing the steps to: - ⁠Complete a short written assessment - Participate in an AI-powered interview Important: Your application is only complete once you finish all steps via the email link. Please note: these AI Lab missions are not traditional job openings with fixed start dates. Project demand is highly dynamic and matching depends on your expertise, availability, and current AI Lab needs. Some experts are matched within days, while others may wait longer for a suitable project. Join us to help shape the PR expertise of the world’s most advanced AI models! #LI-TT1 ----------------------------------------- NOTE At 10x, there are two types of opportunities: 1. Traditional freelance missions These are regular project-based opportunities where the listed mission is the actual project you may work on. 2. AI Lab roles For AI Lab roles, we scout, review, and approve profiles for access to future project opportunities. The missions listed for AI Lab roles are not traditional job openings. AI Lab work is often highly confidential as this exposes information of what an AI Lab is working on, and project requests are unpredictable. When an AI Lab request comes in, we often need to respond within 24 hours with suitable talent. Matching depends on the specific needs of each AI Lab project and your niche expertise. Once your profile is reviewed and approved, you may be matched to relevant AI Lab projects when suitable opportunities arise. This can happen within hours, but it may also take months, depending on the researchers at the AI labs and their project needs.

acquisition-acquisition:ashbyhq:6630a527.title: Social Coordinator
acquisition-acquisition:ashbyhq:6630a527.description: ABOUT ACQ MEDIA ACQ Media is the in-house media engine behind Acquisition.com http://Acquisition.com and its portfolio of brands led by Alex Hormozi, Leila Hormozi, and Sharran Srivatsaa. Our mission is to build the leading business media organization in the world by 2030. We produce high-performance long-form series, podcasts, and daily social content that reach millions of people around the globe. Our content is not vanity media; it is designed to drive measurable reach, deepen brand influence, and create downstream business impact across the entire Acquisition.com http://Acquisition.com ecosystem. We operate like a studio, not a startup content team. That means structured workflows, batch production, clear performance metrics, and an aggressive commitment to innovation, especially through AI-native production systems. We are building a repeatable content machine that compounds: more output, higher quality, faster iteration, stronger monetization, and deeper brand equity over time. If you're joining ACQ Media, you're not here to just make content. You're here to help build a media powerhouse. ROLE: The social coordinator is the tactical engine of the media department. While the social producer defines the "what" and the "why," you own the "how" and the "when." You will turn the execution layer that turns great strategy into flawless, on-time content. While we value creative eyes, this is not a strategy or directing position; it is a role for an operational specialist who takes pride in being the backbone of flawless social channels. This is an execution role. You are responsible for the last mile of production: ensuring every piece of content is perfectly packaged, captioned, and published on time across all platforms. You have full tactical ownership of our social channels, acting as the final gatekeeper before content reaches our viewers. This role requires extreme discipline and a deep, native understanding of platform tools. You are the person who ensures nothing falls through the cracks, from file naming conventions to community engagement. This role reports directly to the Social Media Producer and must be in Las Vegas, NV or willing to relocate. jobgether-jobgether:lever:d9d09092-c6d8-.title: Mainframe Systems Programmer – CICS
jobgether-jobgether:lever:d9d09092-c6d8-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Mainframe Systems Programmer – CICS based in United States. This is an opportunity for an experienced mainframe professional to provide critical technical support for CICS environments and related OEM software products. You will work with enterprise z/OS environments, supporting customers across multiple time zones and operational requirements. The role combines systems programming, software installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and migration support. You will contribute to customer transitions, operating system upgrades, disaster recovery activities, and ongoing platform optimization. Success in this position requires strong technical judgment, analytical thinking, and the ability to manage priorities in high-pressure situations. The environment is collaborative and client-facing, with opportunities to work independently while partnering with project managers and other technical teams. This is a remote U.S. position with on-call, overtime, and scheduled weekend responsibilities. Provide technical support for CICS Transaction Server (CICS TS) and related OEM software products across enterprise z/OS environments. Fulfill customer service requests and resolve reported technical issues in a timely manner while maintaining high service standards. Install, configure, maintain, upgrade, and enhance CICS TS and applicable vendor software in accordance with established procedures and best practices. Support 24/7/365 operations across multiple time zones, including on-call coverage, scheduled weekends, and overtime when required. Assist with customer migrations and transitions by identifying and resolving technical challenges without disrupting project timelines or targeted migration dates. Collaborate with project managers and other functional teams to prepare customer environments for operating system upgrades and other planned changes. Execute tasks associated with customer disaster recovery plans in coordination with disaster recovery teams. Implement vendor fixes, product corrections, upgrades, and new functionality in accordance with IT service management and change-control procedures. Follow established schedules and procedures to ensure efficient use of technical resources and timely implementation of changes. Contribute to proactive maintenance and optimization activities that improve the stability, performance, and scalability of customer mainframe environments. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent professional experience. At least 5 years of hands-on experience working on IBM zSeries/mainframe platforms, including installation and maintenance of CICS TS and related OEM products. Thorough knowledge of CICS TS capabilities, configuration, installation, tailoring, and operational concepts. Strong experience with IBM SMP/E for software installation and maintenance. Experience with tools and products used to monitor and manage CICS TS region performance. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to diagnose complex technical issues and determine appropriate solutions. Ability to work independently, take ownership of assignments, and manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines. Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills for communicating effectively with customers, project managers, and technical teams. Ability to collaborate effectively while also operating with minimal supervision in a high-pressure environment. Willingness and availability to work an 8:00 AM–5:00 PM local schedule, along with on-call rotations, overtime, and scheduled weekend work. Benefits: Competitive full-time salary range of $65,000–$123,000 , with placement based on skills, experience, internal equity, and business needs. Eligibility for additional compensation programs, including an annual performance-based bonus and potential equity participation. Remote work

rapp-rapp:greenhouse:8045023.title: Data Analyst
rapp-rapp:greenhouse:8045023.description: WHO WE ARE: We think too much marketing isn’t us. It’s mass markets not audiences of one. Homogenous groups to be targeted, not individuals to be inspired. Segments to reach, not people with their own ideas and ambitions. It’s one size fits all and it’s dull. When it comes to individuals, we’re fierce. We stand up for individuality. We speak up against bland, broad-brush generalizations. We fight for solutions that adapt to the individual’s needs, beliefs, behaviors, and aspirations. And we commit to doing this in every aspect of our work for clients and their consumers. We actively foster an inclusive workplace where diversity and individual difference are valued and leveraged to achieve the agency’s vision. And most importantly we value every individual’s well-being. We are Fiercely Individual. HOW WE DO IT: At RAPP we are fiercely focused on the individual and how we can create value from every individual’s experience with a brand. We do this across three capability areas: customer centric consulting, creativity that inspires action and customer experience management. Our data analysts know who that person is. Our strategists understand what they want. And our award-winning Technologists and Creatives know how to get it to them. RAPP is an integral part of Omnicom’s Precision Marketing Group, comprising 4,000 creatives, technologists, strategists, and data and marketing scientists across 40 global markets. MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES / DUTIES Collecting and interpreting data Analyzing results of ongoing digital campaigns Interpret data, analyze results using statistical techniques and provide ongoing reports. Providing technical expertise on data storage structures, data mining, and data cleansing. Reporting the results back to the relevant members of the business Identifying patterns and trends in data sets Working alongside teams within the business or the management team to establish business needs Acquire data from primary or secondary data sources. Defining new data collection and analysis processes Use data to answer key questions about the business. Be the go-to person for any ad-hoc data-related questions. Use statistical and econometric techniques on large datasets to measure results and show key trends Identify causal impact and attribution Analyze experiments Model and predict future performance of users or products Assist teammates using the data: assemble analysis, predictions, visualizations, queries, and dashboards. Create meaningful visualizations that communicate your insights and findings, and drive business goals. REQUIREMENTS / QUALIFICATIONS ACADEMIC BACKGROUND Degree in Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science or any quantitative field REQUIRED EXPERIENCE Experience involving quantitative data analysis to solve problems. Experience with common analytical tools such as R, SPSS, Weka, NumPy, MatLab, etc. Experience in data models and reporting packages. Proficient in Excel Knowledge of web analytics tools such as Google Analytics and Adobe Analytics are highly desirable.. Tools such as Power BI, D3.js, GGplot, Tableau, Pardot

southparkcommons-doppel:ashbyhq:3c072751.description: ABOUT DOPPEL Doppel is building the future of social engineering defense. Our AI-native platform uses agentic AI to protect executives, employees, customers, and brands from phishing, impersonation, fraud, and other AI-powered threats across digital channels. We help some of the world’s most recognized brands detect and dismantle attacker infrastructure while strengthening employee resilience through threat-informed training and simulation. By unifying Digital Risk Protection, Human Risk Management and Email Security, Doppel connects threats into a real-time intelligence graph to power faster disruption, smarter defense, and modern security awareness at scale. Backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz and Bessemer Venture Partners, and trusted by leading enterprises, Doppel is a rapidly growing Series C startup building the future of social engineering defense. Our team combines deep cybersecurity expertise, operational rigor, and startup velocity to solve some of the internet’s most urgent trust and safety challenges. THE ROLE As the Manager, Email Security Architecture, you will lead a team of Email Security Architects responsible for customer onboarding, detection tuning, operational excellence, threat investigation, and strategic customer guidance. This is a highly cross-functional leadership role that sits at the intersection of security operations, customer success, solutions architecture, product, and engineering. You will help define how customers deploy and operationalize Doppel Email Security while serving as a critical feedback loop between the field and our product organization. You will be responsible for building scalable processes, developing team talent, driving customer outcomes, and helping shape the future direction of Doppel's Email Security platform. CUSTOMER SECURITY LEADERSHIP - Serve as an executive escalation point for strategic customers. - Guide customers through Email Security deployments and operationalization. - Help customers improve their defenses against phishing, business email compromise (BEC), impersonation, account takeover, and other social engineering threats. - Lead security reviews, threat discussions, and executive-level customer presentations. - Partner with customer security, messaging, and IT teams to integrate Doppel into existing workflows. - Act as a trusted advisor to security leaders responsible for protecting their organizations from evolving email-borne threats. THREAT OPERATIONS & RESPONSE - Oversee investigations involving phishing campaigns, impersonation attacks, malicious infrastructure, and emerging threat activity. - Help define operational playbooks for investigation, remediation, and disruption. - Partner with internal enforcement and takedown teams to connect inbox threats with broader attacker infrastructure and disruption opportunities. - Drive continuous improvement of detection, investigation, and response workflows. - Help operationalize the connection between inbox threats and Doppel's broader threat intelligence and disruption capabilities. PRODUCT & ENGINEERING PARTNERSHIP - Act as the primary voice of customers and frontline operations for the Email Security product team. - Identify detection gaps, workflow friction, automation opportunities, and platform enhancements. - Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to influence roadmap priorities. - Help define scalable o
